note: Hand-maintained per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-heatr3d-workbench-design.md section 6. Updated only when a gate report lands, never inferred.

thermal.label: exploratory (S1-verified numerics, convergence bands pending)
thermal.detail: Thermal/phase scalars and volumes. S1 passed within the stated validity domain (n<=96 full physics). S2 convergence bands pending.

eqs.label: exploratory (S1-verified numerics, convergence bands pending)
eqs.detail: EQS-derived quantities (Qrf, sigma_T^3D) under the EQS-02 corrected drive (qrf_gradient=masked). sigma_T^3D is a diagnostic, never comparable to 2-D sigma_T.

shape.label: exploratory (S1-verified numerics, convergence bands pending)
shape.detail: Shape-fidelity metrics (IoU, out-of-bounds melt) computed from the phi field; definitions shared with solve3d/shape_metrics.py.

shrinkage.label: exploratory (S1-verified numerics, convergence bands pending)
shrinkage.detail: Densification, shrinkage and warp outputs. No physical anchor exists yet (P2 parked until the rig runs).

solved_map.label: sim-only (design method certified on the dolfinx forward; no S-gate earned)
solved_map.detail: Direct-solve FGM maps from solve3d. The SOLVED label certifies the design method, not heatr3d physics trust.

flir.label: S4 not passed (historical FLIR anchor)
flir.detail: Top-surface temperature comparisons against Allison FLIR data did not pass the pre-registered gates.
